page.layout: One printed page (left page, page 200) of running Greek-Latin dictionary entries in one column; at the right edge, a narrow column of marginal notes (right margin), set in small and cramped type, partly cut off by the binding.

main_text.p: ἐπουράνιος ὁ ἡ coeleftis, ex ἐπὶ & οὐρανὸς ἡ ὁ coelum, Heb.12.12. in f.g.
ἐπουράνια ὧν τὰ scil. σώματα coelum, Eph.1.3.

ἐπω dico. a.1. εἶπα Johan.10.34. a.1. imperat. εἶπον ἅτω. 3.pl. εἰπώτωσαν Act.24.20. aor.2. εἶπον, caret fut. & prat. aor.2. imperat. εἰπὲ, ubi augmentum manet in omnibus modis, Luc.7.v.7. εἰπὲ λόγῳ, jube verbo scilicet ut convalescat famulus meus. aor.2.opt. εἴπωμι οἷς οἱ. a.2.subj. εἴπω ἧς ἡ. a.2.infin. εἰπεῖν. part.aor.2.act. εἰπὼν ὀνῷ ὁ. εἰπᾶσα ἴσης ἡ Johan.11.28.
ἐργάζομαι operor, laboro, lucror. imperf. ἠργαζόμην ἡ ἐτο. Fut. ἐργάσομαι, ἐργὰ Bœotice pro ἐργάσῃ. aor.1. ἠργασάμην ὡ ἀῷ exercui Heb.11.v.33. Matth.26.10. prat.pass. ἠργάσμαι.
ἐργασίας ἡ opera, lucrum, quaestus, Act.19.24.
ἐρεθίζω provoco. F.ἰσω. a.1. ἠρέθισα, 2.Cor.9.2. P. ἠρέθικα.
ἐρεύγομαι proprie eructo. item per metaph. dico, pleno ore profero, à 70. hoc verbo redditur Hebraeum יבג. Est ergo Hebraica phrasis. F. ἐρεύξομαι, Matth.3.25. P. ἠρεύγομαι.
ἐρευνάω ὦ proprie, indago, investigo. ab ἐρεύω interrogo, quaero, item, inquiro, scrutor, Joh.5.

page.notes: Right margin notes are very small and partly cut off by the binding; they are not reliably legible and are not transcribed. Several Greek words and abbreviations are uncertain and may contain errors.
